priority_model.purpose: Prioritise implementation by addressable public-procurement market and commercial capacity while retaining a worldwide discovery backlog.

classes.P1: Largest or most commercially valuable markets with strong enough official access to justify early source-admission work.
classes.P2: High-value second-wave national, multilateral or subnational systems.
classes.P3: Strategic long-tail systems retained for global reach after higher-return gates.
classes.P4: Discovery-only or endpoint-identity-feasibility candidates; no implementation without new evidence.

discovery_indexes.notes: Useful for discovering official and derived OCDS publishers, coverage and data-quality warnings. Registry data cannot replace source-specific official rights and admission evidence.
TED is the authoritative supranational source; national portals are separate sources for below-threshold and source-specific lifecycle coverage.
Country and subnational open-data catalogues are searched for official procurement APIs, bulk files, OCDS, OData and feeds. No automated admission.
